newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mobil unit to supply fuel at new HK airport.
newsitem.headline: Mobil unit to supply fuel at new HK airport.

text.p: Hong Kong's Airport Authority said on Wednesday it has signed a 10-year franchise agreement with Mobil Oil Hong Kong Ltd to provide petrol and diesel within restricted areas of the new Chek Lap Kok airport.
The company will build three filling stations, estimated to cost HK$15 million, to service trucks and cars within restricted areas of the airport, the authority said in a statement.

Terms of the agreement were signed on Wednesday by the Sino-British Joint Liaison Group, a body handling details of Hong Kong's transfer to Chinese sovereignty at midnight on June 30, the statement said.
Mobil operates 40 service stations in Hong Kong and has been one of the suppliers of fuels and lubricants on the Chek Lap Kok construction site since 1992.
The new airport is expected to be operational by April 1998.
